selected_t22_target.target_name: Tap-Drill and ISO-Alternative Direct Value Fidelity
selected_t22_target.root_cause: buildTapDrillBlock() copies hp.value/hp.unit verbatim; buildAlternativeDrillBlock() copies alt.value/unit/source/status/meaning/table/verified_date verbatim. None of these nine fields is ever compared to its source. T19 proves tap_drill.value resolves through the citation against the thread dataset (a different comparison); T21 proves the citation matches source citation fields (not value fields). No check reads hole_preparation.value/.unit or iso_2306_alternative_drill.* at all.
selected_t22_target.affected_projection_field: tapping-profiles.json rows[].tap_drill.{value,unit} (all 29 rows) and rows[].alternative_drill.{value,unit,standard_id,status,meaning,provenance.table,provenance.verified_date} (15 UNC/UNF rows)
selected_t22_target.existing_coverage: none for any of the nine fields beyond alternative_drill.standard_id's generic existence check and .status's enum check
selected_t22_target.exact_missing_invariant: row.tap_drill.value/.unit must equal sourceRecord.hole_preparation.value/.unit; when sourceRecord.iso_2306_alternative_drill exists, row.alternative_drill.value/.unit/.standard_id/.status/.meaning/.provenance.table/.provenance.verified_date must equal its value/unit/source/status/meaning/table/verified_date respectively.
selected_t22_target.why_t13_t21_do_not_cover_it: T13/T14 derive the other tap_drill fields from hp.cross_verified. T19 compares tap_drill.value to a dereferenced thread-dataset value, not to hp.value itself. T21 compares only the citation pointer fields. No prior phase named or touched alternative_drill's direct-copy fields at all.

implementation_contract.validator_behavior_required: Add check 18: for each profile row, look up the source record via sourceRecordById (reused from checks 10/11/13/16/17), compare sourceRecord.hole_preparation.value/.unit to row.tap_drill.value/.unit. If sourceRecord.iso_2306_alternative_drill exists, compare its 7 fields to row.alternative_drill's corresponding 7 fields. Fail on any mismatch naming profile, field, projected value, authoritative value.
implementation_contract.pass_criteria: 0 errors on real data (confirmed by direct inspection); correct failure on a reproduced source mutation for both halves; all other 17 checks and every other validator unaffected.

mutation_test_contract: Temporarily change hole_preparation.value on one real tapping-dataset record (e.g. tap_m3x0_5_cut), backed up first, without touching citation fields, the thread dataset, or the projection. With the pre-T22 17-check validator (temporarily stashed), demonstrate all 17 checks still PASS against the mutation. Restore check 18, re-run: expect FAIL naming the profile, field, stale value, authoritative value. Repeat the pattern on one UNC/UNF record's iso_2306_alternative_drill.value to prove the second half. Restore both files, confirm byte-identical, confirm PASS. Run validator 3x on restored data for determinism.
